results.invariant: At-least-once delivery does not execute the same command twice.
A released or recovered old worker cannot reacquire an obsolete fence.
A stale Worker may reach Raw Kafka but cannot publish browser-visible Accepted events.
At-least-once Session mutation delivery creates one canonical PostgreSQL effect.
A streaming-path failure cannot roll back a complete Pi message already committed to SessionStorage.
A browser-visible failed prefix remains model-visible after Worker replacement.
A successful Run terminal commit does not reconstruct a complete message from the short-lived delta tail.
A Control Plane process replacement does not revoke a healthy fenced Agent Loop.
Checkpoint integrity and compare-and-swap fencing survive cold recovery.
Exactly one terminal Run outcome wins a cancel/complete race.
A superseded dispatcher cannot start external work.
Expired ownership is reconciled only after the orphan runtime is terminated.
